text: 为贯彻落实《住房城乡建设部 自然资源部 金融监管总局关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知》（建房规〔2026〕3号）有关要求，加快构建房地产发展新模式，今天，杭州市住保房管局、市规划资源局、市建委、浙江金融监管局联合发布《关于贯彻落实〈关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知〉的实施意见（试行）》，从加强商品住房预售管理、有序推进商品住房现房销售、推行主办银行制度、加大融资支持力度、优化土地供应管理、支持项目分期开发、实施分阶段竣工备案等方面完善商品住房销售制度。
text_en: To implement the relevant requirements of the Notice of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System (Jian Fang Gui [2026] No. 3) and accelerate the building of a new model for real estate development, today the Hangzhou Housing Security and Real Estate Management Bureau, the Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau, the Municipal Construction Committee, and the Zhejiang Financial Regulatory Bureau jointly issued the Implementation Opinions on Implementing the Notice on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System (Trial), to improve the commodity housing sales system by strengthening pre-sale management of commodity housing, orderly advancing existing-home sales of commodity housing, implementing the lead bank system, increasing financing support, optimizing land supply management, supporting phased project development, and implementing phased completion filing.
